title: Beyond first-order accuracy in continuous-forcing immersed boundary methods, and their well-conditioned projection-based solution
summary: We introduce a refined immersed boundary (IB) methodology that is better-than-first-order accurate in practice, while preserving key properties of "continuous-forcing" IB approaches that retain a singular source term in the governing equations. Our method leverages a smoothed indicator (Heaviside) function, following ideas from multiphase flow and immersed layers formulations, to recast the IB solution as a composite of distinct interior and exterior fields.
